_comment: Test tiers for scripts/test.py (docs/TESTING.md, section 'Tiers'). Plain JSON; every entry carries a one-line reason.
tiers.<name>.suites: keys are a suite id, a glob over suite ids, or 'layer:<layer>' (all suites of a layer, including
ones discovered later). An entry WITHOUT 'cases' runs the whole suite; WITH 'cases' it runs only the case ids matching
those patterns (fnmatch: * ? [0-9] [!x]). The runner passes them to the suite as TEST_CASES; the suites skip the work
of unselected cases where they can (sub-suite / area / phase / journey) and never record them.
'include' pulls in another tier: case lists are merged (a whole suite on either side wins), the including tier's own
args / env / parallel / estimate_s replace the included ones. Nothing is ever deleted: a case left out of smoke and
core still runs in full. Optional per entry: args (appended to the suite command), env, parallel + locks (override
the suite's safety for this tier, e.g. when the cut leaves out the cases that touch shared state), estimate_s.
suites.<id>: may the suite run while other suites use the stack? parallel:false = it runs alone. locks: two suites
holding the same lock never run at the same time. Unlisted suites are serial until someone reviews them.
Check after editing: python3 scripts/test.py tiers --check   (and run <tier> --dry-run for the plan and estimate).

locks.worker: held by no suite since the tune run of 2026-10-28: the job passes suites trigger go through app.jobs.run_once (the worker loop's own lock, never two at once) and are idempotent per tenant, and the scheduler sends every inbox lane in parallel without sleeping. Give it to suites whose assertions depend on job passes they did not trigger themselves

unit.reason: pure logic: no database, no network, no stack

functional.reason: in-process TestClient against its own throwaway schema (vtest); never calls the live API

contract.reason: reads the frontend source and /openapi.json only

new_features.reason: own sign-up workspaces W/W2; purge acts on its own ids only

contacts.reason: runs the global CRM purge job (every tenant's recycle bin) and times the 10k import and search latency (CM-090..094)

sales_pipeline.reason: own workspaces; its scheduler / sales_jobs passes go through run_once (the worker loop's lock, never two at once) and are idempotent per tenant: the recycle / stale-deal parts act only on rows a suite back-dates itself, alerts are one per deal per week; the daily new-contact limit is per user. No worker lock (measured, tune run 2026-10-28)

outreach.reason: own workspace and mailboxes; its send_safety passes go through run_once and apply the same per-(tenant, domain) / per-campaign rules the bounce and complaint events already apply, so a pass from another suite changes nothing it asserts; IMAP fake on an ephemeral port, OUT-007 lockout on its own user and X-Forwarded-For. No worker lock (measured)

api_sweep.reason: touches only its cached tenants A/B; its cases do not depend on other traffic (only the informational ENDPOINT_COVERAGE.md metrics diff counts other suites' requests)

ab_testing.reason: own sign-up workspace; tracking and stats inside it

admin_controls.reason: own workspace; AC-010/012 hit the per-user invite-resend limit of its own user only

behaviour_fixes.reason: own workspace; polls only its own rows

contact_scoring.reason: own workspace; the recompute runs in the API request for that tenant

crm_kpis.reason: own workspace; every KPI is computed from the data it seeds

webhooks.reason: its only job pass is run_once('webhooks'): outbox delivery, idempotent, under the worker loop's lock; receiver on its own port 18765, and no other suite asserts on its tenant's deliveries. No worker lock (measured)

e2e.reason: a sign-up workspace per journey; the hourly jobs it runs on demand go through run_once and are idempotent per tenant; the scheduler sends every inbox's lane in parallel without sleeping, so other suites' sends do not delay its own; every SES stand-in check filters by its own recipients / domain; J6 opts agent 3 out of e-mail before its deal exists, so an early sales_jobs pass cannot mail it. No worker lock (measured). Inside the suite J1 runs in a thread next to J2-J6 (run_journeys --serial for one after another)

reports_platform.reason: login lockout / per-IP limit probes lock this client IP for ~15 min and a 25-user load test measures latency: alone and last

ui_outreach.reason: own cached workspaces with a per-workspace X-Forwarded-For; seeds and asserts inside them only

ui_crm.reason: SQL-created tenants of its own; UIC-SAL-26's sales_jobs pass goes through run_once and only adds the one-per-week stale-deal alerts other suites already expect from the worker. No worker lock (measured)

ui_features.*.reason: each file uses its own Tenant.get('<area>') tenant, wiped at its start

ui_features.platform_admin.reason: pauses / resumes the global scheduler (platform_flags.scheduler_paused) and creates a PLATFORM_ADMIN user

smoke.description: Every deploy, including UAT: is the build alive and safe? unit + functional, contract, the J1 journey (all but J1-103), ~25 key screens and the security slice of the API sweep.

unit.reason: fast, catches logic regressions before anything touches the stack

functional.reason: API behaviour, permissions and tenant isolation in-process; the cheapest broad check

contract.reason: every frontend call still has a backend route (seconds)

e2e.reason: J1 is the revenue path: import -> campaign -> send -> reply -> deal -> report. J1-103 (step-3 spread after resume, ~10 min of paced sends) runs in core/full; J1-102 no-burst stays in smoke.

api_sweep.reason: security slice: 401 without/with bad credentials, 403 per role and permission, tenant isolation, duplicate/idempotent writes (409); the phases with none of these (VAL, HIER) are skipped

ui_outreach.reason: key outreach screens: login, home, campaigns list / wizard step 1 / analytics / details + its inbox tab, unified inbox, email accounts, domain health, team, reports; agent route guards and API 403s

ui_crm.reason: key CRM screens: contacts list + record, companies, lists, import (render -> preview -> run), leads, deals, pipeline, sales reports; agent sees only own contacts

ui_features.session_auth.reason: signed-out redirect, API 401 without credentials, CSRF on cookie-authenticated writes

ui_features.platform_admin.reason: platform admin console signs in; tenant admins kept out; platform admin kept out of tenant screens (no scheduler / tenant-status cases, so parallel-safe)

core.description: Nightly and before a build goes to UAT: smoke + every system suite + every e2e journey + the UI suites cut to one case per screen / feature plus every security and permission case.

layer:system.reason: all system suites, whole (new run_*.py suites join automatically)

contacts.reason: whole suite but the 10k-row import / search latency cases (CM-090..094): a latency measurement next to a --jobs pool measures the pool; they run in full. Without them it joins the pool: its global CRM purge only removes contacts deleted > 90 days ago, i.e. rows a suite back-dated itself (ui_crm UIC-RD-01 counts its back-dated one as gone either way)

reports_platform.reason: whole suite but the 25-user concurrency load test (RP-131): load testing runs in full. Stays serial: RP-130 times the dashboards (< 3 s), which a busy pool would distort

ui_outreach.reason: first case of each screen block (it renders the screen and needs no earlier case) plus every auth / role / isolation case; chained flows kept whole where later steps need the earlier ones (reset-password 3x, wizard, 2FA)

ui_crm.reason: one case per CRM / sales screen and per feature on the busy screens (contacts: list, sort, search, columns, filters, views, board, add, properties, bulk, export, duplicates), plus every AGENT / manager permission case; add-contact cases 23-25 share one modal

ui_features.a11y_smoke.reason: per screen: every control has an accessible name; per modal: role=dialog + aria-modal (the h1 / keyboard / focus-trap checks run in full)

ui_features.mobile_layout.reason: per screen at phone width: no sideways scroll, no errors; phone navigation and content width (tablet and modal fits run in full)

ui_features.ab_subject_variants.reason: the feature: variants A/B added in the step editor and stored

ui_features.admin_controls.reason: one per control: list rename, prospect-list rename, resend invite, hierarchy (+ the no-cycle guard), add domain

ui_features.behaviour_fixes.reason: six cases, each a different fix: all of them

ui_features.contact_scoring.reason: score column, record score card, settings rule, agent kept out of settings

ui_features.crm_kpis.reason: KPI tiles, the sales-head dashboard card, agent scoping

ui_features.discount_approval.reason: one approval flow; every step needs the previous one

ui_features.platform_admin.reason: console sign-in, roster, tenant detail, suspend -> refused login -> reactivate, add tenant, stats, every guard and the scheduler switch with its 403s

ui_features.session_auth.reason: every case is a session / auth security check

ui_features.template_library.reason: screen, create, and every sharing / visibility rule between admin and agents; UIF-TL-04 (rename) because UIF-TL-09 checks the renamed template

ui_features.webhooks.reason: screen, add endpoint, signed test delivery, agent kept out

full.description: Release candidates and weekly: every suite, every case. 'run all' is the same tier.
